items.title: Panzani and Cerealis to create a 1.8-billion-euro European pasta giant
items.summary: French pasta manufacturer Panzani and its Portuguese industry peer Cerealis are in exclusive merger talks. The merger is valued at approximately 1.8 billion euros. Both companies currently have a strong presence in different markets and are therefore primarily geographically…

items.title: Red is the new green: Zespri unveils a new type of kiwi
items.summary: After green and yellow, there is now also a red kiwi. Zespri has chosen Belgium as the first European market for its new variety. However, this debut will be short-lived: due to the limited harvest, the fruit will only be available for a few weeks.

items.title: Grupo DIA Appoints LetterOne CEO Jonathan Muir As Chairperson
items.summary: The board of directors of Spanish retailer Grupo DIA has appointed Jonathan Muir as non-executive proprietary chairperson.

items.title: European Council wants to eliminate procurement barriers (once again)
items.summary: Last Friday, the European Council once again emphasized the urgent need for measures to remove barriers to the internal market. The conclusion also explicitly mentions territorial supply constraints.

items.title: Chocolate maker Lindt takes action at the top following two profit warnings
items.summary: Chocolate maker Lindt & Sprüngli is replacing CEO Adalbert Lechner after the company was forced to lower its growth forecasts twice this year. Former CEO Dieter Weisskopf is temporarily taking the helm again and has been tasked with restoring profitability and growth.

items.title: Italy’s Ce.Di. GROS’s SIR Partnership Model Launches Across Two Formats
items.summary: Roman-based supermarket consortium GROS has announced a major strategic expansion beyond its core territory in the Lazio region.

items.title: Carrefour offers 152 million for Colruyt subsidiary Codifrance
items.summary: Colruyt Group has received a binding offer of 152 million euros from Carrefour for its French wholesale division, Codifrance. A sale should allow Colruyt to further focus on its strategic priorities as a food and health retailer.

items.title: German Potato Prices Increase As 2026 Harvest Set To Decline – Destatis
items.summary: Potato prices have risen for German consumers and producers, as 2026’s harvest is expected to be nearly 25% lower than 2025’s.

items.title: Farm-Her – UN Declares 2026 The International Year Of The Woman Farmer
items.summary: Women managed 17.2% of the EU’s utilised agricultural area (UAA) in 2023, according to the latest figures published by Eurostat.

items.title: Hacker Inti De Ceukelaire: “People used to be the weakest link. Now it’s AI.”
items.summary: Artificial intelligence promises retailers a revolution in efficiency and customer service. But its vulnerabilities are also becoming increasingly apparent. Ethical hacker Inti De Ceukelaire says, “You have to know how a dog behaves before you let it around small children.”

items.title: MATRADE Opens At SIAL – Connecting 43 F&B Companies, International Buyers
items.summary: MATRADE officially opened the Malaysia Pavilion at SIAL Paris 2026, showcasing 43 companies offering a diverse range of products.

items.title: Albert Heijn is back online, but Ahold Delhaize’s U.S. websites are not yet
items.summary: Albert Heijn's app and website are back online, and e-commerce will resume on Friday. At Delhaize, e-commerce is fully operational. However, Ahold Delhaize's U.S. websites are still down due to the cyber incident.
